verdict.rationale: Riveter's marketing says you can schedule any project to monitor for changes, refresh as often as every minute, and automatically track competitor pricing. The docs also offer webhooks, but they fire on run completion (run.completed/stopped/finished), not when content actually changes. Change-specific alerting would likely need your own diffing of results. Missing for 10: documented change-detection or diff events, webhook notifications triggered by detected changes, API/SDK documentation for configuring schedules, independent or hands-on corroboration of monitoring.
